dishes.name: French onion soup
dishes.desc: Onions simmered in beef stock, topped with bread and gratinéed Gruyère. A Les Halles market dish, served in brasseries today.

dishes.name: Jambon-beurre
dishes.desc: A baguette with butter and ham, Paris's everyday sandwich. Sold in every bakery and café.

dishes.name: Croque-monsieur
dishes.desc: A toasted ham and cheese sandwich with béchamel, topped with a fried egg as a croque-madame. A Paris café classic since 1910.

dishes.name: Steak-frites
dishes.desc: Pan-seared steak with chips and sometimes a pepper or Béarnaise sauce. The standard dish of a Paris brasserie.

dishes.name: Parisian macaron
dishes.desc: Two almond meringue shells around a ganache or jam. The Paris version is made in dozens of patisseries.

dishes.name: Éclair
dishes.desc: A choux pastry filled with cream, topped with fondant icing. One of Paris's most-loved patisserie items.

dishes.name: Croissant
dishes.desc: A flaky, buttery crescent eaten for breakfast. Paris bakeries compete for the best butter version.
